title: Nine Feet of Wool
subtitle: 地毯与铺设 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地毯与铺设（生活与学习·居家与器物）
meta: 主题语境：地毯与铺设（生活与学习·居家与器物）　|　核心词汇：carpet　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 carpet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my mother was sent to lay ① a carpet she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson. The ② carpet, meaning the wool and not the floor, was nine feet wide and was beaten by whoever came last; a carpet, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ carpet in that house had the same pattern, and the ④ carpet at the front, meaning the one the parlour kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever laid properly. A carpet, my grandmother said, is nine parts wool and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the wool is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ carpet was the whole of the room, meaning the room it made and not the wool. The ⑥ carpet, meaning the room and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody walks on and nobody questions; a carpet, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a wool and a room. She said the room is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ carpet had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the pattern. The ⑧ carpet of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of beating; a carpet, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ carpet I remember is the one at the front, which was beaten in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ carpet, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being walked on; every carpet, she said, is a room that has agreed to look like a wool. She said the room was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 地毯（指那块羊毛织品本身，与地板相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay a carpet 铺一块地毯
D. n. 地毯（指那座房子里每一块）
E. n. 地毯（指前面那一块）
F. n. 地毯（抽象：它造就的那个房间）
G. n. 那个房间（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a carpet she could not lift
The carpet, meaning the wool and not the floor
carpet was the whole of the room
the carpet had become a photograph in a report
The carpet of the whole thing
A carpet, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: lay a carpet 意为“铺一块地毯”，1950 年母亲被派去铺一块她抬不动的地毯。
carpet 意为“地毯”，指那块羊毛织品本身而不是地板，宽九英尺，由最后走的人拍打除尘。
carpet 指那座房子里每一块地毯，每一块都是同样的图案。
carpet 指前面那一块（客厅用的那一块），是唯一有人认真铺过的。
carpet 意为“地毯”，抽象指它造就的那个房间，父亲说 carpet 就是那个房间的全部。
carpet 为抽象用法，指那个房间本身，是屋子里人人都踩、却没人质疑的东西。
carpet 意为“地毯”，到 1967 年这块 carpet 成了报告里的一张照片。
carpet 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的拍打。
carpet 意为“地毯”，我记得的是前面那一块，1972 年拍打过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
carpet 为抽象总称，祖母说地毯是唯一会因为被人踩踏而变好的东西。

那块地毯，指的是那块羊毛织品本身而不是地板，宽九英尺，由最后走的人拍打除尘。（carpet）
那座房子里每一块地毯都是同样的图案。（carpet）

父亲说 carpet 就是那个房间的全部，指的是房间本身而不是那块织品。（carpet）
1976 年祖母说，地毯是唯一会因为被人踩踏而变好的东西。（carpet）
answers: In 1950 my mother was sent to lay a carpet she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson.

Every carpet in that house had the same pattern.
The carpet at the front, meaning the one the parlour kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever laid properly.
My father said carpet was the whole of the room, meaning the room it made and not the wool.
A carpet, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being walked on.
